sources.description: The source type for NagVis maps, typically automap for dynamic topology discovery.

alias.description: Human-readable alias name for the NagVis map definition.

parent_map.description: Parent map ID this map belongs to, used for hierarchical navigation.

iconset.description: Icon set style to use for hosts and services in the map.

backend_id.description: ID of the backend configuration used to fetch status data.

label_show.description: Whether to show labels for objects (1=true, 0=false).

label_border.description: Border style for labels (e.g., transparent, white, etc.).

render_mode.description: Rendering mode for automap, e.g., directed or undirected.

rankdir.description: Direction of graph layout: TB (top-bottom), BT (bottom-top), LR (left-right), or RL (right-left).

width.description: Default width of the map canvas in pixels.

height.description: Default height of the map canvas in pixels.
